title: SNOWFALL
author: CLOUDYPISTON
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'd like to introduce **SNOWFALL**, a multiplayer FPS game where players battle each other with snowballs, playable directly in your browser!

I'm developing this game independently under the name **Cloudy Piston Games**.

I want to be completely transparent from the start: **the project is roughly 50% developed by me and 50% with the help of AI.**

AI assists me throughout the development process, but the ideas, creative direction, and overall vision behind the game are my own.

SNOWFALL is still a work in progress, so don't expect everything to be perfect just yet. There's still a lot to improve, polish, and add.

I'm not trying to prove that AI can replace game developers. I simply want to create something fun using the tools and resources available to me.

🎮 **You can try SNOWFALL here:**  
[https://snowfall.cloudy-piston.co.uk](https://snowfall.cloudy-piston.co.uk)

I'd really appreciate your honest feedback, whether it's positive or negative. Constructive criticism is always welcome!

**What do you think about projects like this? Would you play a multiplayer FPS developed partly with AI?** ❄️

Thanks for checking it out and supporting indie development! ❤️

**Cloudy Piston Games**
